newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks boosted by electricity bids.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks boosted by electricity bids.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed higher on Friday after a flurry of afternoon buying following the announcement that electricity group Endesa is bidding for Sevillana and Fesca, traders said.
The General index gained 4.00 points, 1.06 percent, to 380.82. The Ibex-35 closes 55.10 points, 1.27 percent up at 4,377.37.
"The movements in the electricity sector boosted the index, but the market needs to cool down now and we should see a period of consolidation in the short term," said one trader.
Advances in the bond market and other key stock markets also lent support to Madrid stocks, traders said.
The announcement of Endesa's intention to take over regional electricity companies Fecsa and Sevillana helped boost other companies in the sector.
Iberdrola surged 4.55 percent to 1,380, while Union Fenosa advanced 3.9 percent to 864.
Endesa gained 260 pesetas to 8,210. Fecsa, who received an offer for 1,100 pesetas a share, rose 5.5 percent to 1,055. Sevillana, with an offer of 1,300, rose 6.8 percent to 1,245.
Elsewhere in the stock market Telefonica gained 10 pesetas to close at 2,515. Repsol slipped 10 pesetas to 4,440.
